Shostakovich Violin Concerto No. 1 with Julian Rachlin, Strauss Sinfonia domestica
note: matinee repeat Sun 8 Nov 11:00; also Worms 5 Nov

description: Shostakovich Violin Concerto No. 1 with Julian Rachlin, Strauss Sinfonia domestica
details:
The third Friday subscription concert of the Deutsche Staatsphilharmonie Rheinland-Pfalz in the Pfalzbau concert hall: chief conductor Michael Francis, with Julian Rachlin as soloist in Shostakovich's Violin Concerto No. 1 in A minor, op. 77, then Richard Strauss's Sinfonia domestica, op. 53.

Friday 19:30; the same programme is played on Sunday 8 November at 11:00 (matinee) and on 5 November in Das Wormser, Worms. Tickets from 18 EUR (mvp.de).
